items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) listed doubtful for Week 3 vs Broncos after missing practice again; Sean McVay says barring setback he could return next week vs Eagles.
items.why: No practice progress; McVay candid on limited improvement but not long-term.
items.implication: Sit Nacua; elevate Davante Adams to WR1.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate and strong production on 142 routes without Nacua.

items.text: Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR after imaging and specialist consults; week-to-week and aiming to return ASAP, but already ruled out this weekend vs Seahawks.
items.why: Consensus after evals that non-IR path viable.
items.implication: Positive longer-term; Mariota starts short-term. McLaurin value not fully tanked.
items.opportunity: McLaurin 25% target share historically with Mariota.

items.text: Packers WR routes without Jayden Reed (neck/back): Christian Watson 45, Matthew Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks; Watson & Golden combined 48% of Love targets so far.
items.why: Heavy route shares in first game sans Reed.
items.implication: Watson/Golden elevated in GB passing game.
items.opportunity: Near-even high route volume; prior target concentration.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) updates indicate may miss Sunday in Brazil; limited/no practice progress after Week 1 aggravation.
items.why: Soft tissue + poor Brazil field conditions heighten risk.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth elevated; Bateman etc.
items.opportunity: Prior full practice absence since aggravation.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) DNP multiple days and expected to miss second straight game vs Colts; status very much in doubt.
items.why: No practice participation; Grade 1 but slow return.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes targeted / 28% share last week without Collins; Colts allow TE yards.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
Dalton Schultz LOVE @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week without Nico Collins; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.
items.why: Elevated usage sans Collins + strong TE matchup.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 42%; results include 8-195-2 vs NYG.
items.why: High target rate and production in Nacua absences.
items.implication: Adams clear WR1 if Nacua out again.
items.opportunity: 42% target share on routes without Nacua.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched Stevenson 16-5 post-fumble; Drake London >20 PPR/35% share/97 ypg with Penix; Schultz 30%/28% sans Collins.
items.implication: Henderson rising but Stevenson still ranked ahead by Berry; London smash with Penix; Schultz stream.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% route rate this season, 8% target share (6 targets through 3 games); TPRR 33% with London off field vs 17% on.
items.why: Low involvement especially with London active.

items.text: Nick Bosa pulled calf in Thursday practice; expected to miss a few weeks including vs Cardinals; 49ers leaning against IR due to roster spaces.
items.implication: 49ers DL depth tested; limited fantasy skill impact.

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D and high prop.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave (vs LV, high aDOT/air yards, LV allows 18.7 ypr to WR), Parker Washington (36% share, deep targets), Christian Watson (WR8 util, 38% RZ share).
Hates Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX, low snaps/touches post-fumble, tough run D), Travis Etienne (vs LV, low 49% touches/38% 3rd down), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA, fewest WR pts allowed, low team total).
items.opportunity: Stevenson lost snaps to Henderson; Etienne committee.
